decisions.statement: The old slug is read from the page type's own file name.
A path naming no page type is refused here.
The pages of that page type are read from the index in one call.
Every page and every file a page claims is moved in this one answer.
The page type's own file and every file it claims move in that same answer.
The files a page claims are read while the page type still declares them.
The page type a page states is restated at the path that page landed at.
A page stating its page type under both keys has both keys restated.
Every page's address is restated over one reading of the bodies.
The page type's own address is restated beside the addresses of its pages.
That restating comes before any file a page claims is moved.
The pages are carried before the page type's own file is renamed.
The slug the page type states is restated in the body that page type landed in.
The name the page type's own body exports is spelled from the new slug.
The type a page type's worked file exports is spelled from the new slug.
The type a page type's types file exports is spelled from the new slug.
A body importing a type spelled anew imports the type the new slug names.
Every body importing what moved is repointed over one map of what moved.
A body that moved names its own imports by the paths its new name reaches.
A manifest naming a file that moved as a way in states where that file landed.
No rung beneath is reached.
The folder a page type owns is left where that folder sits.

definition: a page type renamed, in its own name and in every page filed under that page type
